programs.name: International Bachelor Econometrics and Operations Research

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

profiles.notes: Entry to Econometrics and Operations Research. Each diploma route applies only to applicants presenting that qualification.

requirements.label: School diploma and final-year mathematics
requirements.details: The committee assesses the highest-level diploma actually awarded. The curriculum must be academic and include mathematics through the final school year. Foundation programmes, vocational courses, equivalency certificates and SAT or ACT scores cannot substitute for the required qualification.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: US diploma, AP exams and GPA
requirements.details: An accredited US high school diploma requires a GPA of at least 3.00 in grades 11 and 12. Take four independent approved College Board AP exams with Calculus AB or BC at 4/5 or above and each other qualifying AP at 3/5 or above. If the calculus condition is unmet, submit a mathematics proficiency certificate with the application.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Independent AP exams and language study
requirements.details: US History and World History count as one exam, as do Microeconomics and Macroeconomics. Only one language AP may count, and a World Languages and Cultures AP is accepted only as a fifth exam. Two final school years taught entirely in English exempt a US diploma holder from a separate English test, including at schools outside the US.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: British GCSE and A-level route
requirements.details: Present at least three GCSEs or IGCSEs and three accepted A levels, including A-level Mathematics, across six different subjects. The published grade range is A*–C. Include the GCSE results in the application.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: A-level subject combinations
requirements.details: Mathematics, Further Mathematics and Statistics overlap. Further Mathematics and Statistics can count as an extra fourth A level. Languages other than the listed English subjects count only as a fourth A level. English Language, English Literature and the combined course cannot fill multiple slots among the first three.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Singapore A-levels
requirements.details: Submit three approved H2 academic subjects, including a pass in H2 Mathematics, one H1 subject, and General Paper or Knowledge and Inquiry. Pass all four A-level subjects at C or higher. O-level English Language or first-language GCSE/IGCSE English must be at least B.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: European Baccalaureate
requirements.details: Take English as language 1 or 2 for at least three hours per week. Take at least five hours of mathematics per week and achieve at least 75/100.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Dutch VWO mathematics and English
requirements.details: All VWO profiles can qualify. Take final exams in Mathematics B and English. Mathematics D counts only alongside B. Mathematics A requires an additional maths exam, and applicants without final-exam English need an accepted language certificate.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Dutch applied mathematics propaedeutic diploma
requirements.details: Only Applied Mathematics (ISAT 35168) is listed. The weighted GPA must reach 7.5. Present OMPT-D above 75% or a listed VWO Mathematics B certificate before 1 May. English as a course requires 7.0. If English is absent, take a proficiency test unless the entire programme was taught in English.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Remedying a mathematics curriculum deficiency
requirements.details: Applicants with strong results in a curriculum below Dutch VWO Mathematics B can demonstrate proficiency through OMPT-D or a Mathematics B certificate from the Dutch state exam, Boswell-Bèta or CCVX. Only the first attempt counts. Low school mathematics marks or missing final-year mathematics cannot be remedied through this route.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: English test thresholds and validity
requirements.details: Where a test is required, submit a result no more than two years old by the application deadline. Overall minima are IELTS Academic 6.0, TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new scale, PTE Academic 61, LanguageCert 65, Cambridge B2 First or C1 Advanced 170, or Cambridge C2 Proficiency 180. The school sets no separate component minimum.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: English test format for immigration
requirements.details: Non-EEA applicants needing a Dutch visa or residence permit must test at an official centre. The school excludes home tests, IELTS One Skill Retake and TOEFL MyBest for this purpose. It allows EEA students to use online versions.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: West African Senior Secondary School Certificate
requirements.details: Submit six or more general academic subjects with C6 or higher on the WAEC certificate. Pass both an English language test and the additional mathematics exam.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education
requirements.details: Present A, B or C in at least six KCSE subjects, and pass the English and mathematics proficiency tests.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Moroccan baccalaureate
requirements.details: The school lists the Lettres and Sciences streams of the Attestation du Baccalauréat. Both the English test and the additional mathematics exam are required.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: South African National Senior Certificate
requirements.details: The NSC must endorse bachelor’s admission with at least seven accepted subjects, a 70% average and no mark below 55%. English as a home language exempts the English test. The mathematics exam remains required.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Rolling selection and school grades
requirements.details: Applications are individually reviewed on a rolling basis. The committee considers school results, especially mathematics and English. Final-year students present penultimate-year results, current grades and predicted final grades; Dutch VWO applicants can omit the VWO 5 transcript. Graduates can submit final results already available at application.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Motivation, experience and CV
requirements.details: Answer the programme’s motivation questions in the portal. The selection committee considers the CV, including international and extracurricular experience. The programme aims for a cohort with at least 50% international students.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics admission 2027–2028

requirements.label: Application opening and nationality-based deadlines
requirements.details: Applications open 1 November 2026. The deadline is 1 April 2027 for non-EU/EEA nationals requiring a Dutch residence permit and 1 May 2027 for EU/EEA applicants. Register in Studielink, then answer the questions and submit the documents in the EUR Admission Portal by the applicable deadline.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics application for entry in 2027

requirements.label: Handling fee by diploma and double application
requirements.details: A non-Dutch diploma carries a non-refundable €100 application fee. Applicants also applying to the BSc² in Econometrics and Economics may apply to both, pay once and request the second fee exemption in the portal.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics application for entry in 2027

requirements.label: Final diploma and transcript deadlines
requirements.details: After an offer, upload certified final grades and diploma, with sworn translations where applicable, by 1 August. For (I)GCE A-level and Irish Leaving Certificate applicants, the deadline is 21 August.

source.title: Erasmus School of Economics · Econometrics application for entry in 2027
